ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-medium; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the central 60% of the surface area with high-intensity (white/grey) streaks and mottling concentrated on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation mass extends from the insertion point to the median notch; lateral lobes exhibit high-contrast white linear streaks and grey mottling, particularly on the distal edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 130 degrees and shallow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; sharp peaks visible at the distal tips and adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity circular pixels detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally toward the central axis on both lateral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel scarring (rake marks) across the ventral surface of both lobes; significant irregular jaggedness on the trailing edge indicative of historical tissue trauma.
